about: Turns typed text into tags a person can remove one at a time. Enter or a comma adds a tag, Backspace at the start of the input highlights the last tag and removes it, and every change is announced.

editing.about: `editable` lets a person fix a tag in place: a double press on a keyword, or Enter on the highlighted one, opens it. `max` stops at five and keeps a sixth keyword in the input, and the helper text counts the controlled value.
editing.title: Editable, capped keywords

enter: Press Enter or type a comma after each address.
label: Add a label

palettes.about: Each tag takes a palette from its value through `ItemPreview`'s `palette`, and a label without one is neutral. `sanitizeValue` lowercases what a person types, so `Bug` finds the palette of `bug`. The tags are the library's `Tag` in its subtle look.
palettes.title: A palette per tag

pasted: Paste addresses separated by commas to add them all at once.

pasting.about: `addOnPaste` splits pasted text at the delimiter, a comma by default, and adds each part as a tag. The clear trigger removes every tag at once.
pasting.title: Adding a pasted list

required.about: A required field in a form. Submitting with no skill marks the field invalid and shows its error text, which the first tag clears.
required.title: Required, in a form

size.about: The control reads the control scale and each tag the tag scale at the same size. The input's text starts at the inset of an input of that size.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: An empty tags input shows its placeholder. A highlighted tag takes the focus ring's color. An invalid one draws the error edge. A read-only one keeps its tab stop and hides the triggers, and a disabled one is dimmed and leaves the tab order.
states.title: States

status.about: Every status in every look. A status sets the control's edge and focus ring from its palette.
status.title: Statuses

title: Tags input
used: {{used}} of {{most}} keywords. Double-click a keyword to edit it.

validated.about: `validate` refuses a tag that is not an email address. The refused text stays in the input to be corrected, and `onValueInvalid` shows the error text until the next keystroke. `blurBehavior="add"` adds the typed address when focus leaves the input.
validated.title: Validated addresses

variant.about: The three looks of the control, the same as the input group's. The flushed look draws the block-end edge alone, and its tags start at the edge.
variant.title: Looks
